title: Manual top-level CLI command map
intent: Prove every root fulcrum command dispatches to the intended handler, prints coherent help, and rejects unknown commands without falling through.
acceptance: Inventory root commands from main and index dispatch tables
Simulate help, version, unknown command, and one happy path per root command
Verify stdout, stderr, and exit code semantics for JSON and text modes
anti_patterns: Assuming generated command presence means root dispatch works
Letting hook subcommands share product command semantics
critique_focus: dispatch completeness, help discoverability, exit-code consistency
manual_simulation: Run each root command with --help or minimal no-op args
Capture stdout/stderr boundaries
Confirm unknown command suggests valid domains
incentive: Full command/control PRD needs one reliable root map before deeper workflows.

title: Generated CLI domain parity contract
intent: Turn the 52 generated command domains and 310 subcommands into a PRD coverage matrix with required examples, adapters, and simulation status.
acceptance: List every generated domain and subcommand
Mark which commands have real surface adapters versus placeholder generated invocation errors
Require one manual simulation row per create/read/update/delete/action/watch shape
anti_patterns: Counting generated files as usable commands
Skipping nested commands such as deliveries get or retention-policy set
manual_simulation: Sample each generated domain help
Run one command per operation shape with fake or dev API
Record whether command reaches public API, local caller, or placeholder error
incentive: Prevents PRD from claiming command coverage that only exists in generated stubs.

title: Product task command control loop
intent: Specify manual coverage for product task create/list/workbench/update/bulk/move/run-preview/run/run-feed/run-worker/qa-review paths.
acceptance: Cover all task commands in product HELP
Verify required flags, unknown flags, CSV task parsing, and board mode parsing
Verify JSON output for preview, dispatch, live feedback, worker tick, and QA review
anti_patterns: Treating run-feed --watch as same as non-watch output
critique_focus: dependency execution and PM task parity
manual_simulation: Create task then list with filters
Preview single-task and board dependency runs
Dispatch run then read feed and worker tick
Submit qa-review with review file
incentive: Task command coverage is core product control surface for human and agent workflows.

title: Product planning command suite
intent: Define PRD coverage for freeform start, guided ACP start, continuous update, technical planning generation, prompt preview, materialize, and acceptance-cycle commands.
acceptance: Exercise all product planning commands from HELP
Validate file inputs for preview/materialize and JSON payload inputs for acceptance-cycle
Assert prompt/source-doc/project/trace/acp-session/mode/model/permission propagation
anti_patterns: Testing docs-only planning without ACP/session fields
Using one synthetic command to represent all planning modes
manual_simulation: Run freeform, guided ACP, continuous update, generate, preview, materialize with fixture files
Run malformed file and missing flag paths
Compare trace IDs across outputs
incentive: Planning command coverage anchors PRD expansion for human and agent journeys.

title: Review, UAT, final QA CLI flows
intent: Specify manual simulation for final QA, feedback gate, UAT handoff, decisions, auto-decision, E2E run, review workbench, review sessions, and annotations.
acceptance: Cover every product reports and review command in HELP
Validate decision/type/severity enumerations and error text
Verify diff/annotation file parsing and viewed-file/hide-viewed behavior
anti_patterns: Skipping annotation line range and side fields
Treating plan-only E2E as equivalent to execution
manual_simulation: Run each review/report command with fixture JSON and diff files
Run invalid severity and missing review-or-trace cases
Validate command output includes trace, review id, status, and next action
incentive: Review/UAT gates determine when agents can truthfully hand work to users.

title: Product parser flag matrix
intent: Document every product boolean/value flag, unknown flag behavior, missing value behavior, repeated flag policy, and passthrough limitations.
acceptance: List BOOLEAN_FLAGS and VALUE_FLAGS as the canonical product parser contract
Define acceptance for --flag value and --flag=value forms
Verify unknown, missing value, boolean with value, and numeric coercion errors
anti_patterns: Letting command-specific flags bypass central validation
Assuming generated commander behavior matches product parser behavior
manual_simulation: Run representative command with every shared flag family
Run malformed unknown and missing-value variants
Confirm stderr and nonzero exit
incentive: Flag correctness decides whether CLI can be safely automated by agents.

title: JSON and text output contract
intent: Require each command to declare whether it prints JSON, text table, NDJSON stream, status text, or stderr-only diagnostics.
acceptance: Classify output mode per root and generated command
Verify --json emits parseable JSON only on stdout
Verify watch/stream commands use NDJSON or documented event framing
Verify errors do not corrupt stdout JSON
manual_simulation: Pipe --json commands to jq
Run stream commands and parse each line
Trigger API error and malformed input paths
incentive: Machine-readable output is required for agents supervising CLI workflows.

title: Install, uninstall, component lifecycle commands
intent: Define manual simulation for install/uninstall/component/components flows, profiles, dry-run behavior, and agent runtime side effects.
acceptance: Inventory install profiles and dry-run paths
Verify component plan/execute/status commands
Verify uninstall preserve/remove choices and generated runtime files
Ensure commands report changed files and skipped actions
anti_patterns: Running destructive uninstall without dry-run fixture
Not separating user config from generated sentinel blocks
manual_simulation: Run dry-run install and component plan in temp HOME
Run install twice and compare output
Run uninstall dry-run and verify warnings
incentive: Lifecycle commands mutate user agent installs and need explicit control specs.

title: Hook subcommand control surface
intent: Specify command behavior for format, lint-gate, pm-policy, test-on-edit, audit-log, index-check, index-rebuild, tool-output-router, hook, and hooks.
acceptance: Inventory each hook command input source and output policy
Verify stdin/stdout/stderr contracts and JSON modes where present
Simulate pass, fail, skipped, and malformed payload cases
anti_patterns: Treating hook commands like normal user commands
Dumping large tool output to stdout
critique_focus: agent hook reliability and bounded output
manual_simulation: Feed minimal valid and invalid hook payloads
Run hook commands under temp repo fixture
Verify exit codes match blocking semantics
incentive: Hook behavior controls multi-agent safety and output routing.

title: Doctor, database, and health commands
intent: Define manual coverage for doctor, db, health, server/API readiness, PGlite/PostgreSQL status, and health-check output.
acceptance: Inventory doctor text and JSON reports
Verify db ping/status/init/reset plan command behavior
Validate unavailable DB, missing env, PGlite default, and configured URL paths
Confirm health output maps to actionable subsystem status
anti_patterns: Conflating config warnings with hard failures
manual_simulation: Run doctor with temp config
Run DB commands with missing and fake DATABASE_URL
Parse JSON health output
incentive: Users and agents need reliable readiness diagnostics before running workflows.

title: Skills, marketplace, and upstream skill controls
intent: Specify manual simulations for skills sync/list/lint/budget, marketplace commands, upstream-skill mirroring, and conflict/lock generated commands.
acceptance: Inventory handwritten skills commands and generated fulcrum_skills commands
Verify sync target selection for agent runtimes
Verify conflict resolution, lock override, install, uninstall, upgrade, and budget output
Check source backup pruning and metadata size warnings
anti_patterns: Assuming Claude plugin and nested skill installs behave identically
Mutating real home directories during simulation
manual_simulation: Use temp CODEX_HOME/CLAUDE_HOME/GEMINI_HOME fixtures
Run sync/list/conflict commands
Verify generated files and warnings
incentive: Skill control surfaces are high-risk because they span multiple installed agents.

title: MCP, connector, webhook, and notification commands
intent: Define PRD coverage for MCP registry/builtins plus connectors, webhooks, notify, subscriptions, and audit integration commands.
acceptance: Inventory MCP add/list/remove/doctor behaviors if present
Exercise connector list/get/enable/disable/sync/runs commands
Exercise webhook create/list/delivery commands and notify rules/channels/quiet-hours commands
Cover watch subscription commands
anti_patterns: Skipping secret redaction for webhook/notify config
manual_simulation: Use fake API responses for connector/webhook/notify commands
Run watch subscription with bounded timeout
Verify redaction and JSON output
incentive: Integrations need explicit command control before PRD claims operational completeness.

title: Docs, memory, context, search CLI workflows
intent: Specify manual command simulations for docs, doc comments, versions, links, memories, context assemble/preview, and search query/saved/suggest paths.
acceptance: Cover create/list/get/update/delete for docs and memories
Cover comments, backlinks, versions diff/restore, templates, context assemble, and search facets
Verify pagination, scope, archive, global/project, and JSON/text output
anti_patterns: Treating search text output as enough for API clients
Ignoring doc body markdown file and inline body behavior
critique_focus: knowledge retrieval and documentation workflow completeness
manual_simulation: Create doc, add comment, list versions, restore version
Create/search/promote memory
Run search query and saved search commands
incentive: Knowledge commands are core to local-first Agent OS context workflows.

title: Project, sprint, task relationship command suite
intent: Define manual coverage for projects, sprints, tasks, task hierarchy, relationships, comments, custom fields, saved views, templates, automations, and recurrence commands.
acceptance: Map project/work item commands across handwritten and generated surfaces
Exercise state changes, hierarchy, dependencies, comments, field updates, saved views, automation, recurrence
Verify filters, CSV arguments, and project scoping
anti_patterns: Testing isolated CRUD without workflow transitions
Duplicating CLI surfaces with conflicting flag names
critique_focus: PM command coverage and no duplicate semantics
manual_simulation: Create project, sprint, task, dependency, comment, saved view, automation, recurrence
Move task through status/sprint and inspect outputs
Run invalid relationship and missing project cases
incentive: PM command completeness is central to Fulcrum's product workflow PRD.

title: Agent run and orchestration commands
intent: Specify manual simulations for agents, agent_runs, runs, orchestration subscriptions, Symphony, run cancel/retry/detail, and worker control paths.
acceptance: Cover agent profile list/get/test
Cover run create/list/get/cancel/retry and subscription watch
Cover Symphony sync/status/retry/cancel where present
Verify run IDs, trace IDs, status transitions, and cancellation output
anti_patterns: Treating run create as same as dependency-run dispatch
manual_simulation: Run profile list/test with fixture caller
Create or dispatch run, cancel, retry, and inspect detail
Run subscription watch with bounded events
incentive: Agent run controls are the command surface for supervising autonomous work.

title: Repository, artifact, import/export, and backup commands
intent: Define manual command coverage for repos, repo branches/commits, artifacts, import/export, backups, data import/export, and artifact accept/reject/archive workflows.
acceptance: Cover repo register/list/status/sync/unregister plus branch/commit generated reads
Cover artifact list/get/upload/download/archive/delete/accept/reject
Cover import csv/jira/github/trello and data import/export preflight/run/create
Verify dry-run, hard delete, file path, and binary output behavior
anti_patterns: Writing downloads into repo without temp target
critique_focus: filesystem side effects and data movement safety
manual_simulation: Use temp repo and artifact files
Run import dry-run and data preflight
Upload/download/archive/delete artifact in fixture API
incentive: Data movement commands need explicit safety and output contracts.

title: Auth, settings, secrets, credentials, telemetry, theme, flags commands
intent: Specify manual control coverage for auth invites/whoami, settings, secrets/credentials, telemetry opt-in/out/purge, theme, feature flags, experiments, and routing config.
acceptance: Exercise auth invite/accept/whoami and org/member commands
Exercise credentials set/get/rotate/archive/remove with redaction expectations
Exercise telemetry status/opt-in/opt-out/purge, theme get/set/update, flags set/evaluate/experiments
Verify no secrets leak to stdout/stderr
anti_patterns: Ignoring enum choices for theme and rollout
manual_simulation: Run credential commands with temp store
Run telemetry purge in fixture state
Run flag rollout and theme update with invalid enum cases
incentive: Configuration commands affect trust, privacy, and access control.

title: Inference command coverage
intent: Define manual simulation for inference health, provider config, backends, models, generate, embed, classify, tokenize, and watch output.
acceptance: Inventory handwritten and generated inference commands
Verify provider set/test/config get/set, model pull/rm/list, generate/embed/classify/tokenize
Simulate unavailable sidecar, invalid model, streaming watch, and JSON output
anti_patterns: Mixing generated and handwritten command semantics
manual_simulation: Run health against missing and fake sidecar
Run generate/embed/classify/tokenize with fixture provider
Verify watch stream event format
incentive: Inference controls gate agent execution quality and local runtime readiness.

title: TUI global navigation and status contract
intent: Specify manual simulation for launcher navigation, router paths, status bar, bell count polling, command palette, help overlay, and screen registry coverage.
acceptance: Inventory every registered screen and route alias
Verify global navigation keys, status bar current screen, org/user/bell state, help overlay, and palette action dispatch
Verify unknown route and disabled feature handling
anti_patterns: Testing screens only as isolated classes
Letting palette actions point to missing routes
manual_simulation: Launch TUI with FakeTTY and real terminal mode
Navigate every registry item
Open palette/help/status states and verify screen names
incentive: Full TUI command/control depends on dependable navigation shell.

title: Task list control keys and overlays
intent: Define manual simulation for task list search, selection, bulk update, dependency preview/dispatch/feedback, QA review, manual workbench, and view toggle controls.
acceptance: Cover keys slash, j/k, space, B/b, R/r, D/d, F/f, Q, V/v, escape, backspace
Verify overlays render and caller methods receive selected task IDs and trace IDs
Verify subscription feedback updates displayed events
anti_patterns: Skipping multi-select and empty selection behavior
manual_simulation: Drive every key in FakeTTY and terminal
Select multiple tasks and bulk update
Preview, dispatch, watch feedback, and QA review selected task
incentive: Task list is the densest TUI PM control surface.

title: Task detail edit and relationship controls
intent: Specify manual simulation for task detail overlays: edit title, status, assignee, child, comment, dependency/blocker, link, custom fields, and create task.
acceptance: Cover keys escape, e, s, a, c, p, d, l and submit methods
Verify each overlay labels current action and calls correct caller method
Verify validation and refresh behavior after save
anti_patterns: Merging child creation with dependency creation
manual_simulation: Open task detail and execute each overlay with valid and invalid inputs
Verify resulting task payload and trace/link fields
Return to list without losing state
incentive: Task detail must support full manual PM control without leaving TUI.

title: Board, calendar, and timeline navigation controls
intent: Define manual simulation for board columns, calendar/month movement, timeline/gantt movement, task open, and task creation.
acceptance: Cover h/l or left/right, j/k or up/down, enter, create key, and empty states
Verify focus movement across columns/dates/timeline rows
Verify task open route and create-task submission
anti_patterns: Rendering board only as static columns
manual_simulation: Run board/calendar/timeline in small and wide terminal sizes
Move focus through all regions
Open task and create task from focused context
incentive: Visual PM surfaces need manual keyboard proof, not just source assertions.

title: Project list and detail workflow
intent: Specify manual controls for project list navigation, create, delete confirmation, open detail, tabbed project detail, and dashboard summary.
acceptance: Cover project list keys y/Y/n/N/q/escape/j/k/c/d/enter
Verify create overlay and delete confirmation behavior
Verify project detail tab focus with tab and j/k
Verify dashboard recent runs and project summaries
manual_simulation: Create project, open detail, navigate tabs, delete with cancel and confirm
Verify dashboard refresh reflects project state
incentive: Project control is the entry point for every scoped PM workflow.

title: Sprint and report controls
intent: Define manual simulation for sprint list activation/create, sprint planning move/remove, active sprint quick-add/close, and report chart/tab navigation.
acceptance: Cover A/c on sprint list, m/x on planning, c/C on active sprint, and report numeric/tab keys
Verify close disposition, capacity changes, days remaining, and chart output
Verify old and new ReportsScreen variants do not conflict
anti_patterns: Testing reports as static ASCII only
Skipping sprint close with incomplete tasks
manual_simulation: Activate sprint, create sprint, move/remove tasks, quick-add task, close sprint
Switch every report and inspect chart labels
incentive: Sprint and reports are high-frequency manual PM controls.

title: Runs and artifacts keyboard control
intent: Specify manual simulation for run dispatch/detail/cancel/retry/dependency preview and artifact list/preview/upload/download/archive/delete/filter/multiselect.
acceptance: Cover runs keys j/k/d/D/c/C/r/R/p/P/enter and artifact keys u/d/a/D/f/space/y/n/escape/enter
Verify run detail live updates and disposal
Verify artifact preview for text/image/binary and batch operations
manual_simulation: Dispatch run, open detail, cancel and retry, preview dependencies
Upload/download/filter artifacts and batch archive/delete selections
incentive: Agent execution needs reliable terminal supervision controls.

title: Agents, orchestration, and inference screens
intent: Define manual coverage for agent list/detail/dispatch, orchestration live subscription, orchestrator pane retry/cancel/detail, and inference sidecar/model controls.
acceptance: Cover agents j/k/enter/d/q and submitDispatch
Cover orchestrator pane j/k/enter/r/x/escape
Cover inference start/stop/status/model list behavior
Verify subscription update and dispose paths
manual_simulation: Open agents, dispatch selected agent to task
Receive orchestration update then retry/cancel selected run
Toggle inference sidecar and handle unavailable socket
incentive: TUI must supervise agents, not merely display them.

title: Docs tree, reader, memory, context screens
intent: Specify manual simulation for docs tree navigation/create/delete/scope toggle, reader edit/history/save, memory facets/search/detail/edit/archive, and context preview.
acceptance: Cover docs keys q/escape/j/k/enter/n/g/d/left/right and reader e/h/save
Cover memory keys q/escape/g/p/tab/f/G/slash/j/k/enter/a/d/e and submitEdit
Verify context preview displays source refs and snapshot IDs
anti_patterns: Testing docs as flat list only
Ignoring long markdown and terminal wrapping
manual_simulation: Create and open docs in global and project scopes
Edit/save reader content and inspect history
Filter/search/edit/archive memory and open context preview
incentive: Knowledge controls connect docs, context, and memory inside terminal workflows.

title: Search, activity, inbox, and notification rules
intent: Define manual coverage for search query/palette/facets, activity filter chips, notifications mark/read/mute/open, and notification rule creation/edit/delete/toggle/quiet hours.
acceptance: Cover search keys Ctrl+K/S/tab/g/space/j/k/enter/escape and submit query methods
Cover activity tab/space/j/k filter chips
Cover inbox tab/R/A/M/j/k/enter and notification rules N/E/D/space/j/k plus quiet hours
anti_patterns: Not testing mute and open-entity side effects
manual_simulation: Run search, save/palette action, apply facets
Navigate activity chips and reload
Mark/mute/open notifications and edit notification rules
incentive: Triage surfaces determine whether operators can keep up with agent activity.

title: Settings tabs and destructive controls
intent: Specify manual simulation for settings tabs: theme, secrets, errors, backup, telemetry, feature flags, data import/export, auth, and i18n/feature-gated states.
acceptance: Cover settings tab/shift-tab, j/k, enter, R/D/C/P/space and submit methods
Verify destructive reset/delete/purge confirmations
Verify auth provider display and i18n disabled/enabled states
Verify feature flag toggles and rollout/cohort inputs
anti_patterns: Treating disabled feature screens as missing
manual_simulation: Navigate every settings tab
Submit valid and invalid config changes
Run destructive paths with cancel and confirm
incentive: Settings screens carry high-risk state changes and need explicit PRD gates.

title: Routing rules TUI editor and dry-run tester
intent: Define manual simulation for routing rule list, tabs, new/edit/delete/approve drafts/test/raw JSON dry-run, and invalid JSON errors.
acceptance: Cover h/l tab navigation, j/k, n/e/d/t/a/r/y/n/escape keys
Verify submitRuleForm and submitDryRun caller payloads
Verify draft approve/delete, raw JSON validation, and dry-run result rendering
anti_patterns: Testing routing rules as read-only table
Not distinguishing active rules from drafts
manual_simulation: Create and edit rule, test with task JSON, approve draft, delete rule
Run invalid JSON and confirm error message
incentive: Routing controls govern which agents receive work.

title: Repos, connectors, and webhook screens
intent: Specify manual coverage for repo list/detail/register/sync/filter/logs/file tree plus connectors/webhook display and action states.
acceptance: Cover repo keys j/k/r/s/enter/f/l/left/right and submitRegister
Verify repo detail tabs for file tree, branches, commits, status, sync logs
Define connector/webhook list and action simulation requirements
anti_patterns: Skipping register path and filter log path
critique_focus: repository supervision and integrations from TUI
manual_simulation: Register repo, sync, open detail, navigate files/logs
Render connectors/webhooks with enabled and failed states
incentive: Repository and integration screens connect PM work to actual codebases.

title: Audit log and doctor screens
intent: Define manual simulation for audit paging/date/export/filter chips and doctor subsystem list/detail/rerun behavior.
acceptance: Cover audit E/j/k setFilters setDateFilter submitExportPath
Cover doctor q/escape/j/k/enter/space behaviors and subsystem detail output
Verify export path, empty events, failed subsystem, and rerun states
manual_simulation: Filter audit by date and export
Open doctor details for pass/warn/fail subsystem
Rerun checks and verify status updates
incentive: Operators need terminal-native diagnosis without leaving TUI.

title: Review and planning TUI workflows
intent: Specify manual coverage for planning screen, planning breakdown controls, review workbench session list/actions, QA report, approve/request changes/save/open.
acceptance: Cover planning keys j/k/R/G/F/enter and planning breakdown r/m/c/n/a/p/u/g/e/x
Cover review keys j/k/R/A/X/S/enter
Verify artifacts, materialization, generated plan, freeform/guided context, and review status output
anti_patterns: Skipping materialize and artifact execution controls
manual_simulation: Start planning context, generate breakdown, materialize, execute artifact, open review, approve/request changes
incentive: Planning/review are core Fulcrum workflows and must be keyboard-controllable.

title: Reusable TUI widget behavior
intent: Define manual and automated coverage for StatusBar, VirtualList, Palette, FilterChips, HelpOverlay, ASCII charts, truncation, and renderer color behavior.
acceptance: Verify widget key handling and render output across narrow/wide terminals
Verify virtual list cursor/window bounds
Verify palette escape/enter/up/down and filter chip tab behavior
Verify charts avoid overflow and renderer strips ANSI in tests
anti_patterns: Only testing widgets through one screen
Letting long text overflow terminal width
critique_focus: terminal UI polish and no layout breakage
manual_simulation: Render widgets at 40, 80, and 120 columns
Drive widget keys directly and inside screens
Inspect ANSI/no-ANSI output
incentive: Widget correctness prevents repeated screen-specific layout defects.

title: CLI/TUI/API surface parity matrix
intent: Create a PRD matrix linking every major CLI command family to a TUI screen/action and public API/service route where parity is expected.
acceptance: Map domains: projects, tasks, docs, repos, artifacts, notifications, runs, reports, planning, review, settings
Mark gaps where CLI has command but TUI has display-only screen or no screen
Mark gaps where TUI has action but CLI lacks equivalent command
Define manual parity scripts for representative workflows
anti_patterns: Treating CLI and TUI as independent products
Comparing only labels rather than behavior
interactions: CLI command to TUI key mapping
manual_simulation: Run one workflow through CLI then same through TUI
Compare persisted state and trace IDs
Record missing surface equivalents
incentive: PRD expansion needs exact parity claims, not separate feature lists.

title: Shared manual simulation harness
intent: Specify fixture, command runner, FakeTTY, real terminal, fake API, and evidence capture harness required to validate CLI and TUI command/control coverage.
acceptance: Define how to run CLI commands with temp HOME, fake API, and captured stdout/stderr/exit
Define how to run TUI screens with FakeTTY plus selected real terminal smoke cases
Define artifact format for manual proof screenshots/logs and failure reproduction
anti_patterns: Manual testing directly against user HOME
Relying only on unit tests for interactive controls
manual_simulation: Build a checklist runner that executes CLI and TUI scenarios in temp dirs
Capture logs and terminal snapshots
Validate cleanup after run
incentive: Manual simulation is explicitly required and must be reproducible across agents.

title: Generated command documentation audit
intent: Determine whether generated command docs exist, whether source-generated command files are the only docs, and what docs must be produced for PRD expansion.
acceptance: Inventory generated docs or confirm absence
Compare generated command signatures with docs templates and snapshots
Require docs for domain, subcommand, flags, choices, output mode, examples, and manual simulation status
anti_patterns: Assuming codegen snapshot is user documentation
Publishing command docs without output examples
manual_simulation: Search generated command docs locations
Generate or inspect docs templates in temp output
Compare docs against command source inventory
incentive: Users cannot manually simulate commands they cannot discover.

title: Error, empty, loading, and unavailable state coverage
intent: Require CLI and TUI PRD acceptance for missing API, missing flags, empty lists, permission denied, unavailable sidecar, failed subscriptions, and partial data.
acceptance: List expected error/empty/loading states per command family and screen
Verify CLI errors separate stdout/stderr and exit nonzero
Verify TUI renders actionable empty/error copy and keeps navigation usable
Verify subscription failures clean up without stale status
manual_simulation: Run CLI with missing config and bad API responses
Render TUI screens with empty/failing callers
Verify recovery and retry flows
incentive: Command/control coverage is not complete until failure states are specified.

title: Trace, link, and identity propagation
intent: Specify CLI/TUI requirements for projectId, taskId, runId, traceId, runGroupId, reviewId, docId, artifactId, and memory IDs across workflows.
acceptance: Inventory all ID fields accepted and emitted by CLI/TUI actions
Verify trace/link IDs survive create, run, review, docs, artifacts, memory, and reports flows
Define visible TUI placement for IDs and machine-readable CLI placement
anti_patterns: Generating new trace IDs silently when user supplied one
Using inconsistent field names between CLI and TUI
manual_simulation: Run paired CLI/TUI workflows with explicit trace IDs
Compare emitted IDs against persisted state
Verify copyable ID display in TUI
incentive: Trace/link continuity is the backbone of Fulcrum workflows.

title: TUI accessibility and keybinding help coverage
intent: Define PRD acceptance for every interactive TUI screen to expose discoverable key help, focus indication, no-overlap layout, and accessible status language.
acceptance: Every screen with handleKey has visible or help-overlay key descriptions
Focus cursor is visible and stable in list/table/detail views
Narrow terminal render has no incoherent overlap
Color is not sole status signal
anti_patterns: Undocumented keys hidden in tests only
manual_simulation: Open each screen at narrow/wide widths
Trigger help overlay and compare with actual handleKey cases
Inspect no-color output and focus labels
incentive: Manual command/control only works if users can discover and see controls.

title: Destructive action confirmation and safety
intent: Specify command/control requirements for delete, purge, reset, hard delete, uninstall, restore, token/secret changes, run cancel, artifact delete, project delete, and credential operations.
acceptance: Inventory all destructive commands and TUI keys
Require confirmation behavior or documented non-interactive safety flag
Verify dry-run/plan mode where appropriate
Verify secrets are redacted and destructive outputs name target IDs
anti_patterns: Immediate irreversible action from single key without confirmation
manual_simulation: Run destructive actions in temp fixtures with cancel and confirm paths
Verify explicit target names/IDs and exit codes
Run secret commands and inspect logs
incentive: Unsafe destructive controls would block PRD acceptance regardless of feature count.

title: Watch and subscription behavior
intent: Define manual coverage for CLI watch commands and TUI live subscription screens, including event framing, cleanup, reconnect, and inactive completion.
acceptance: Inventory CLI --watch commands and generated subscription commands
Inventory TUI screens that subscribe to live updates
Verify event format, termination, cleanup on screen exit, and reconnect/error state
Verify no duplicate events after resubscribe
anti_patterns: Leaving streams open after screen change
manual_simulation: Run watch commands with bounded fake event stream
Navigate away from TUI subscription screens
Inject duplicate and failed events
incentive: Live feedback is critical for supervising long-running agent work.

title: Large list and terminal performance coverage
intent: Specify PRD requirements for large task/doc/artifact/audit/search/run lists in CLI and TUI, including pagination, virtual list, truncation, and bounded output.
acceptance: Identify commands and screens requiring pagination or virtualized display
Verify CLI limit/offset flags and bounded default output
Verify TUI renders large lists within frame budget and truncates long text
Verify search/filter interactions remain responsive
anti_patterns: Dumping thousands of rows by default
manual_simulation: Seed 1000 tasks/docs/artifacts/events
Run CLI list defaults and paginated variants
Render TUI large lists and measure responsiveness
incentive: Large real workspaces must stay operable from CLI/TUI.

title: End-to-end CLI/TUI workflow scripts
intent: Define full manual simulation scenarios that combine CLI and TUI from project creation through task planning, run dispatch, review, artifacts, docs, and final QA.
acceptance: Define at least five cross-surface journeys: PM-only, agent run, docs/context, review/UAT, integration/notification
Each journey lists exact CLI commands, TUI keys, expected persisted state, and evidence artifacts
Verify switching surfaces does not lose trace or project context
anti_patterns: Independent smoke tests with no journey continuity
Only mocking API responses without state transitions
manual_simulation: Run each journey in temp workspace against fake or local API
Capture CLI logs and TUI snapshots
Compare final state through public API
incentive: PRD expansion should describe real journeys, not disconnected commands.

title: Command/control coverage tracker artifact
intent: Specify a durable tracker that records every command, flag, output mode, TUI screen, keybinding, status state, test file, and manual simulation result.
acceptance: Tracker has one row per CLI command and one row per TUI action/key
Rows include source path, test path, manual simulation command/keys, output evidence, and pass/fail state
Tracker can be regenerated from source inventory and manually annotated without clobbering evidence
All initial PRD items remain passes:false until manually proven
anti_patterns: Freeform checklist detached from source files
Only tracking test files rather than user actions
Marking pass from static analysis alone
manual_simulation: Generate inventory from source
Annotate manual results after running scenarios
Diff regenerated inventory against tracker after code changes
incentive: Without a tracker, CLI/TUI PRD expansion will drift as commands and screens change.
